payout_quote: Earn $20 when you refer a new Respondent user who earns $75 in total incentive. (Official Respondent page, collected 2026-09-23)
timing: Paid after your referred user earns $75 in total study incentives
eligibility: Respondent participant account; the referred person must be a new Respondent user who goes on to earn $75 in total study incentives
steps: Create your free Respondent participant account
Copy your personal referral link from the Respondent platform
Share it with someone who fits research-study demographics and will actually complete studies
Your referral completes studies until they have earned $75 in total incentives
catches: HIGH BAR: your referral must earn a full $75 in study incentives before you get anything - most casual signups never complete enough studies
Study qualification is competitive - screeners reject most applicants, so even motivated referrals may stall
Respondent takes a 5% fulfillment fee ($1 minimum) from participant incentives
Incentives are paid via Tremendous eGift, not direct cash deposit
No payout for referrals who sign up but never earn - only completed earnings count
biggest_catch: Your referral has to earn $75 in study incentives first - given how selective study screeners are, most people you refer will never get there and you'll earn nothing.
notes: DEMOTED by coordinator adjudication 2026-09-23: duplicate - same provider and same bonus mechanism already verified at R6613/R6614 (Respondent, new user-testing lane) + R0228 (catalog). Original: Official Respondent page (app.respondent.io, collected 2026-09-23): $20 per new referred user who earns $75 in total incentive. Repeatable per qualifying referral.
maximize: Only refer people with in-demand professional demographics (software, product, healthcare, finance roles get selected far more often) - a generic referral to a student will likely never clear $75. Walk them through completing their profile 100% and applying to 5-10 studies in their first week; early momentum is what separates earners from dormant signups. Track who you've referred so you can nudge the ones closest to the $75 line.
